cells.gaps: No instrument held makes the Minimum Interoperability Standards compulsory and names who enforces them, and no department is reported following them; an update of the standards was in progress in 2026 (ZAF-001).
cells.note: The DPSA says it published the Minimum Interoperability Standards to guide departments, an adopted and published framework; the 2026 work to update them does not unsay it. No held fact says an instrument makes them compulsory and names an enforcer, so it stops at stage 3.
